description: Vera Aesthetics visual theme — navy/bone/gold system. Source of truth: ../../vera-brand-identity.md and the template spec ../../vera-posts.html. Slide canvas is 1080×1350 (4:5). Deliberately distinct from the MSS house identity and from PureMed.

fonts.note: Neither family is installed on the machine, so without these embedded files the slide renderer silently falls back to Georgia and system-ui. Both are OFL variable fonts from Google Fonts (licences alongside the TTFs). bodySemi points at the same variable file as body: the weight axis covers 600.

logo.note: iconWhite is an alias, not a third asset: Studio's own Brand mode (content-branding.js) only recognises the FSC-era key names fullTextWhite/iconWhite/fullTextBlue, so without it the app chrome shows no logo.

slideRules.headlineColorNote: Bone. REQUIRED: the shared slide renderer (scripts/slides/graphics.js) draws every text card on a dark gradient and defaults the headline to palette.primary. Vera's primary IS the navy background, so without this override headlines render navy-on-navy and are invisible.
slideRules.styles: bone (warm off-white bg, ink text, gold eyebrow + gold hairline rule), navy (deep-navy bg, bone text, gold eyebrow — the signature/cover/close), stone (soft greige neutral), photo (bg image + navy scrim from 34% to 72%, bone text bottom-anchored)
slideRules.frame: no inset frame; a 64×2px gold rule under the eyebrow/headline carries the accent
slideRules.footer: leaf mark + lowercase 'vera' wordmark in Fraunces, bottom-left; swipe indicator or CTA bottom-right

footer.note: Lowercase wordmark only. The renderer colours footer.accent with palette.primary, which is navy-on-navy (invisible) for Vera, and the brand's footer lockup is the mark plus 'vera' anyway.
